name: avegancafe
description: Kyle's personal Claude plugin: a home for one-offs that don't warrant their own plugin. Ships the work-notes-vault skill (his private Obsidian work vault and its Granola + voice-recorder transcript archives), /slurp (transcribe the USB voice recorder into that vault), hifi-h2 (tag music from MusicBrainz and load it onto his Rockbox HIFI H2 player), phone-push (send a push notification to his phone now or at a scheduled time via a cloud routine), and flipper-usb (build, launch, debug and drive his Flipper Zero over USB, including GPIO boards like an ESP32 Marauder card).
